integrity: The finite checks are independent enumerations and transfer recursions; the infinite-size theorem relies on the written combinatorial proof. All relevant physical model distinctions from cited studies are explicit.
scientific_limitations: Classical Ising spins, equal positive nearest-neighbor couplings on triangular rungs and matched periodic legs, uniform longitudinal field, n>=3; no finite-temperature or quantum claim. Novelty is supported by examined literature but not independently certified.
title: Exact field plateaux and ground-state multiplicities of a frustrated three-leg Ising tube
